subject: Warm standby activation procedure & RPO sampling request
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <audit@cardinalbank.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: warm standby activation procedure + RPO sampling logs

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the walkthrough on Monday. As part of Cardinal Bank's SIG-B assessment we need a compact set of artifacts showing how Redwood performs a warm-standby activation for a primary inference service and evidence that RPO targets are met during failover windows. Specifically we need:  

- A step-by-step activation procedure (runbook) you would follow to promote warm standby into active for the inference API (including who is authorized to trigger).
- A short timeline sample (CSV or similar) with observed KV cache warm times and end-to-end request latency during a controlled activation (ideally last 30 days).
- RPO sampling evidence across at least three simulated events (timestamps + snapshots) showing data durability and recovery point.

Can you confirm whether you can provide these artifacts by next Wednesday (8/6)? We may also request a live witness (30–45m) to observe an activation during a maintenance window. If possible, note whether the evidence is from prod or a production-like warm standby.

Attachments requested: runbook PDF, kv-cache logs, rpo sample CSVs.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Cardinal's procurement needs these for the SIG submission.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Senior InfoSec Auditor
Cardinal Bank

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <audit@cardinalbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 11:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: warm standby activation procedure + RPO sampling logs

Hi Lena — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the artifacts you outlined and propose the following delivery plan:  

1) Deliverables by 2025-08-05 (before your 8/6 target):
   - warm-standby-activation-v1.3.pdf (detailed runbook, roles, and approval gates)
   - kv-cache-warm-log-20250729.csv (sample of recent warm starts with per-shard timestamps)
   - rpo-sample-timestamps-20250701-20250729.csv (three annotated simulated activations)

2) Live witness: we can host a 30-minute session during your preferred maintenance window. For production safety we recommend witnessing against a dedicated warm-standby test slice (identical infra and dataset) — we can also run a recorded activation in prod constrained to low-traffic windows if you need real-prod telemetry.

3) Notes on scope and fidelity: the runbook includes pre-checks (KV warm, prefix priming), traffic cutover steps, monitoring checks, and rollback criteria. The CSVs include both KV warm completion timestamps and request tail-latency percentiles.

I will attach the artifacts to a follow-up email. If you want the live witness, propose two 1-hr windows (your timezone) and we'll confirm ops staff.

Best,

Mina Haddad
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (will follow in next message)

Thanks Mina — that plan sounds good. A couple of clarifications before you send artifacts:

Looking forward to the files.

—Raj
